items.title: If You Invested $300,000 in Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and Keurig Dr Pepper, Here’s What They’d Pay
items.summary: Three soda giants promise retirees steady checks, but one has frozen its payout, another has the thinnest cushion, and all three share the same weak spot. Which one carries the biggest share of the income, and what could knock them all down together?

items.title: PepsiCo Extends KFC Beverage Partnership Across Eight International Markets
items.summary: PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) has renewed its beverage supply agreement with KFC across eight international markets, extending a longstanding commercial relationship between the food and beverage companies. The agreement covers Australia, India, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium.

items.title: Celsius Holdings earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Celsius Holdings Inc (CELH) beat on both lines, yet the stock gave back its premarket pop. Shares were $30.02 (-2.39%) as of Nov 5, 1:24 PM EST. They had opened at $32.84 and traded as high as $33.69. Premarket had been up roughly 5–10%. The market is separating "beat" from "fixed."

items.title: Energy-Drinks Are Exploding. Why Is Celsius Stock Fizzling?
items.summary: The energy-drink industry is growing sales at 15% a year, the fastest in the beverage aisle. But competition is fierce, with each brand staking a claim to niche consumers.

items.title: PepsiCo Lowers 2026 EPS Outlook as North America Pressures Margins
items.summary: PEP cuts its 2026 EPS growth outlook as North American margin pressures persist, while strong international growth and productivity savings offer support.

items.title: PepsiCo Jumps 15.1% in a Month as Investors Weigh What Comes Next
items.summary: PEP shares surge 15.1% in a month as strong international growth and a valuation discount face North American margin pressures and a weaker earnings outlook.

items.title: Is PepsiCo a Buy or a Wait as Value Clashes With Slower EPS Growth?
items.summary: PEP's discounted valuation and strong international growth attract attention, but sluggish EPS growth, debt and North American margin pressures favor caution.

items.title: Can Coca-Cola Keep Expanding Margins While Investing More?
items.summary: KO's margin expansion continues despite higher marketing spending, aided by productivity gains, disciplined pricing and strategic investments for growth.
